content: In the division of a non-divisible apartment, both ex-spouses requested exclusive assignment. Under Art. 720 CC, when a property cannot be split without losing utility, the judge has the discretion to assign it based on subjective and objective factors. The Court found that the wife’s severe health conditions and the excessive burden of relocation constituted a superior interest, justifying the assignment to her despite the husband’s counter-claims. Regarding costs, judicial expenses for CTU are shared equally as they serve the common interest of achieving the division.
